protected_violation_px: original (non-patch) pixels a corrective changed: must be 0
clipped_open_px: stretch-clipped joint-patch pixels still open (a visible conflict)
pop_weight_jump: a drawn asset's activation weight changing by more than 0.5 between adjacent sweep frames (about 10 deg apart or less) = pop; gap fills follow the gap and are excluded
light_speck_increase: decontamination must not add light specks

notes: Moho was not run in Phase 3.4: no mapping is verified.
No Moho Lua API members are used or invented; no .moho file and no exporter are produced.
Smart Bone actions and switch layers are named as the likely native constructs only.

live.drivers: skeletal pose readings only (shoulder abduction, elbow, knee, ankle, clavicle, torso bend); independent of face tracking, IK target source, hand switches and gamepad inputs
live.cloud_inference: none (generators are deterministic geometric constructions; no AI model is called)
